learning_outcomes.text: Creating a positive and lasting relationship with physical activity.
Acquisition and mastery of basic motor skills and abilities in outdoor sports: windsurfing, beach volleyball, water tourism - river rafting, hiking and other sports according to interest.
Training and improving the technique needed for the sports.

assessment_rules: Grades are awarded based on a percentage: A 90%, B 80%, C 70%, D 60%, E 50%. To receive 1 or 2 credits, students must complete a multi-day course in its full scope or complete one-day courses totaling 4 days. Students can choose a course that suits their interests, abilities, and deadlines.
institution: Univerzita Komenského v Bratislave (Comenius University Bratislava)
degree: Bachelor Applied Informatics (1-AIN), Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Informatics
